model.description: 10Eros v1.4 — the current line of TenStrip/LTX2.3-10Eros (v1.3 'full remix' plus restored explicit prompting and motion control; prioritizes avoiding anatomy confusion). Bundles the rank72_energy distilled LoRA at the reference workflow's per-stage strengths (0.68 stage 1 / 0.38 stage 2) instead of v1's condsafe-at-1.0 pairing, and uses the author's abliterated Gemma-3 12B text encoder (~12.8 GB one-time download) as the reference workflows do — better prompt fidelity for explicit content than the standard QAT encoder. Pairs with the 'Reference pipeline' toggle in Advanced Settings for the closest match to the author's published ComfyUI workflow. Available only when Mature Mode is enabled.

prompt: A warm sunny backyard. The camera starts in a tight cinematic close-up of a woman and a man in their 30s, facing each other with serious expressions. The woman, emotional and dramatic, says softly, "That's it... Dad's lost it. And we've lost Dad."The man exhales, slightly annoyed: "Stop being so dramatic, Jess."A beat. He glances aside, then mutters defensively, "He's just having fun."The camera slowly pans right, revealing the grandfather in the garden wearing enormous butterfly wings, waving his arms in the air like he's trying to take off.He shouts, "Wheeeew!" as he flaps his wings with full commitment.The woman covers her face, on the verge of tears. The tone is deadpan, absurd, and quietly tragic.
